# Golden Eagle Insurance Agency

> Golden Eagle is an IRA-licensed insurance agency in Westlands, Nairobi, founded in 2006. It places cover with ten of Kenya's leading insurers and runs a separate global investment advisory.

The agency was ranked first in the Association of Kenya Insurers' professional indemnity category in 2018, 2019 and 2023. It compares insurers for each client, helps file claims and follows them up until they are settled.

## Insurance

- Medical Insurance
- Professional Indemnity
- Home Insurance
- Business Insurance
- Travel Insurance
- Life and Pension
- Cyber Insurance

Insurers: ICEA Lion, Britam, Jubilee, CIC, AAR, AIG, Old Mutual, Heritage, Prudential, NCBA.

## Investment Advisory

Golden Eagle Global Markets Investment Advisory builds and manages diversified portfolios of global shares, funds and bonds for Kenyan investors, held on Investors Trust. It is led by Lydia Wanjiku Mwangi in Nairobi.
